settings.hero_alt: My setup needed these. All eight Evolution Companions plushes in a styled campaign scene.
settings.hero_body: Your favorite beside the screen. The rest above your desk. All eight plush companions, $160 for your complete set.
settings.story_eyebrow: A setup that feels like yours
settings.story_title: You picked the games. Now pick their spots.
settings.story_body: When you sit down to play, they’re right there. One next to the monitor, the others on the shelf above it. Reach over, swap your favorite, start another game.
settings.size_body: Bring one down from the shelf while you play. Leave it beside your controller when you’re done. It’s part of your setup now.
settings.proof_title: Good company for your next game.
settings.proof_body: Zoom in on the tiny smiles and little paws. You’ll be seeing them every time you sit down to play.
settings.final_title: Your setup’s ready for all eight.
settings.final_body: Settle in for a game with your favorite beside the screen and the rest of your collection right there with you.
settings.point_1_body: Give it the spot beside your screen. All eight are included, so you can swap whenever you like.
settings.point_2_title: Put the rest where you can see them
settings.point_2_body: Line them up above your monitor or spread them around your setup. Your favorite games, with your favorite little faces nearby.
settings.point_3_body: Take a favorite off the shelf while you play, then tuck it back into the lineup when you’re done.
